evals.prompt: Check a branch for PR readiness, write a concise PR body, and handle review follow-up safely.
evals.expected_output: A completed response or artifact that follows the skill workflow, includes relevant evidence or paths, and reports validation status.
assertions: Uses the skill-specific workflow instead of generic assistance
Loads or identifies required context before producing final output
Follows the output contract for preparing PRs for review, writing PR bodies, handling review feedback, and readiness checks
Keeps related skill references conditional when the skill may not exist in the target environment
Encourages small reviewable PRs and calls out when unrelated work should split into separate PRs
Reports validation results or explains why validation could not run
Uses full GitHub PR and issue URLs instead of shorthand such as owner/repo#123 or #123
